chunk_findings.detail: The new test is named and justified as pinning vendor-doc sources (D-new-harnesses-2026-11), but it never reads a source. Given a grok descriptor whose process_names, headless argv/autonomy, and autonomy profiles match the three asserts, and whose fact keys are present, while facts["detect.process_names"] (and the other two) have src changed from the vendor note to "guessed", the test still passes. `set(grok.facts)` only proves those paths exist, so the regression this change claims to lock is not locked.
